name: Kamil Postaağası
intro: Kamil Postaağası is an International Trade and Management Information Systems double major at Boğaziçi University and a fund management intern at BV Portföy Yönetimi A.Ş. He works on fund and peer-group performance analysis, fixed income, and fundamental analysis, and builds the Python data pipelines behind that work himself.
bio: At BV Portföy he builds competitive analysis workbooks that benchmark the firm's funds (RUT, BVV, BTK, MTD, BV1) against their TEFAS category peers at position level. He also developed the Python pipeline behind them: KAP API extraction, portfolio allocation report parsing, ticker normalization, and automated audit. Portfolio weights are recomputed independently as position value over total fund size rather than taken from reported percentages.

Previously he was an International Capital Markets and Project Finance intern at the Türkiye Wealth Fund, where he ran Eurobond spread analysis and prepared a research project on sustainable debt, examining PIF's 2025 euro green bond and Xylem's 2026 senior blue notes through primary offering documents. Before that he worked in Kayseri as an export assistant intern at Serhat Mobilya, a furniture exporter serving more than 50 countries.

He is currently building a macro and BIST data dashboard for the investment team, sourced from the TCMB EVDS API, and preparing for the SPL Capital Market Activities Level 3 licensing examinations. His interests are portfolio management, fixed income, fundamental analysis, fintech, and LLM-based workflow automation.
